(holdings held constant, only the rate moves: the Overview currency box's
revaluation). USD holdings move by ``usd x (1/rate_now - 1/rate_then)``; EUR

One session's move in one currency: the Overview's day move, reused as is.

Every figure is the same value the Overview payload carries for that currency
(``kpis.daily_move``, ``kpis.daily_growth_pct``, ``day_split``, ``movers``), so
the Brief can never disagree with the hero. Amounts in that currency.

BriefWindowMove.description:
The book's move over the whole window (``visit_from`` to now) in one currency.

``move = end_value - start_value - net_flows``; ``pct`` is the period-growth
definition ``move / (start_value + net_flows)``. EUR view: ``price_move +
currency_move == move`` (the currency part is the rate's effect on the start
book); USD view: ``currency_move`` is null and ``price_move == move``.

LastSessionMove.description:
The day split into day (``move``) and night (``overnight_currency``).

Day rule of 2026-11-16. Market shut: the day total ``day_move`` is FROZEN at the
close (close prices x the close rate minus the baseline); ``move`` is its
market-hours part (the total minus last night's currency move); ``overnight_currency``
is the currency's move since the close, shown beside the total and NOT part of it.
Amounts in the response currency (each computed in it, never converted).

While the market is open (``market_open``): ``overnight_currency`` is LAST NIGHT's
currency move only (the previous-close book revalued from the previous close rate
``fx_close`` to the rate at today's open ``fx_now``) and ``move`` the session
(everything since the open, prices and intraday FX); ``move + overnight_currency``
is ``day_move``. No ``*_est`` fields then.
